summary: The round-1 fix remains incomplete: banner checks accept extra text inside nested elements, violating criterion 7. All 13 scoped files were reviewed. No files were changed or checks executed.

checks.criterion: AC1: Test-first mode and mock banner behavior
checks.evidence: Source inspection supports the required wording and conditions: components/mode-banner.tsx:10, lib/shell.ts:15, components/mock-banner.tsx:8. components/mode-banner.test.tsx:54 covers PRD titles, G0 statuses, absent G0 and mock visibility. The 642bedb tree contains these tests before the banner implementations. Vitest execution was prohibited by the read-only review instructions.

checks.criterion: AC2: Shared layout includes skip link, banners, navigation, main and versioned footer
checks.evidence: apps/web/app/layout.tsx:23 renders all required elements around children. components/mock-banner.tsx:12 supplies role="status" and red theme classes; app/globals.css:30 defines the red token. components/site-footer.tsx:9 includes bundle and schema versions. Existing .next/server/app/index.html also contains this structure.

checks.criterion: AC3: Seven plain next/link destinations and no prohibited links
checks.evidence: apps/web/components/site-header.tsx:8 imports next/link; lines 11–19 contain exactly the seven required destinations. The claude-r1-2 rebuttal is accepted: criterion 3 explicitly permits unfinished routes to return 404.

checks.criterion: AC4: Keyboard navigation, visible focus and active-route aria-current
checks.evidence: apps/web/components/site-header.tsx:26 renders native links in array order and sets aria-current by exact pathname equality. app/globals.css:67 supplies a visible focus outline. tests/site-layout.test.tsx:121 covers current-route attributes. Browser keyboard and focus verification requires execution, prohibited for this review.

checks.criterion: AC5: PRD wording and factual home-page content
checks.evidence: apps/web/components/mode-banner.tsx:10 copies PRD 4 titles verbatim, including Mode C's incomplete-radar wording. app/page.tsx:13 contains only the title and the factual bundle-records sentence. The root layout retains the three T0 protected texts through the banners and footer.

checks.criterion: AC6: Build-time bundle loading, static home page and passing smoke check
checks.evidence: apps/web/app/layout.tsx:18 uses the existing T0-05 loader, apps/web/lib/bundle.ts; app/page.tsx:8 retains dynamic='error'. Existing .next/prerender-manifest.json identifies / as compute='static'. The loader and config/run.yaml have no diff between the supplied endpoints. Fresh build and smoke execution were prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC7: Test-first main-only equality without weakening protected-text checks
checks.evidence: apps/web/scripts/page-check.ts:108 correctly restricts equality to one main, and line 105 compares complete footer text. However, lines 87 and 94 only require matching text runs, accepting malformed banners with additional child-element text. The codex-r1-1 fix therefore remains incomplete. tests/page-check.test.ts:85 and :113 cover plain-text suffixes but omit nested-element suffixes.

checks.criterion: AC8: Only site-header is client code; no provider or bundle data; measured JavaScript budget
checks.evidence: apps/web/components/site-header.tsx:1 is the sole client directive found in app/components source and imports only next/link and next/navigation. Existing page_client-reference-manifest.js:2 lists site-header as the only application client module. Story notes record 177,190 B versus the 173,974 B baseline, satisfying documentation presence. The claude-r1-1 gzip reproduction remains independently unverified because executing measurements was prohibited.

findings.claim: Validate complete banner text rather than individual text runs. Nested markup still bypasses the exact-text requirement, leaving codex-r1-1 partially unresolved.
findings.evidence:
By inspection, changing MOCK_PAGE's 'not results

' to 'not results yet

' leaves the expected mock text in textRuns, so line 87 accepts the visibly incorrect banner. Likewise, appending '; radar match passed' inside REAL_PAGE's mode paragraph preserves the expected run and the single Shipping mode occurrence, so line 94 accepts it. Main and footer checks remain satisfied. The previous whole-body equality rejected these additions. Compare each banner element's complete rendered text and add negative cases for nested-element suffixes.
